items.name: blur-fade
items.title: Blur Fade
items.description: Fades content in out of a blur, from any direction, on mount or when it scrolls into view.

items.name: chromatic-text-reveal
items.title: Chromatic Text Reveal
items.description: A sentence whose last word is painted in by a moving, colored edge, then swapped for the next.

items.name: scroll-text-reveal
items.title: Scroll Text Reveal
items.description: A paragraph whose words light up one by one as it scrolls up the screen. Shows all the text under reduced motion.

items.name: split-reveal
items.title: Split Reveal
items.description: Words or letters rise out of their own masks and sharpen from a blur, on mount or scroll into view.

items.name: typing-animation
items.title: Typing Animation
items.description: Types text out character by character, optionally deleting and cycling through words. Screen readers get the full text up front.

items.name: morphing-text
items.title: Morphing Text
items.description: Melts one word into the next with a blur and an SVG threshold filter. Screen readers get the whole list once.

items.name: word-rotate
items.title: Word Rotate
items.description: Swaps one word for the next with a short slide and fade. Screen readers get the whole list once.

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Number Ticker
items.description: Counts a number up or down with a soft ease once it scrolls into view. Screen readers get the final value.

items.name: odometer
items.title: Odometer
items.description: A number on mechanical digit wheels that roll to their new faces whenever the value changes. Formats with Intl, so currency and grouping just work.

items.name: rolling-text
items.title: Rolling Text
items.description: Rolls every letter up and swaps it for a copy of itself, on hover, mount or scroll into view.

items.name: split-flap-text
items.title: Split Flap Text
items.description: Departure-board lettering. Tiles flip through a drum of letters on a hinge, one beat apart. Screen readers get the lines once.

items.name: line-shadow-text
items.title: Line Shadow Text
items.description: Text with a hatched, diagonal-lined shadow that slowly slides behind it. The hatching holds still under reduced motion.

items.name: perspective-text
items.title: Perspective Text
items.description: Words or lines stacked in depth on a plane that tilts towards the cursor. Sits at a calm fixed angle under reduced motion.

items.name: scramble-text
items.title: Scramble Text
items.description: Letters cycle through random glyphs and decode into the real text, on mount, hover or scroll into view.

items.name: shine-text
items.title: Shine Text
items.description: A band of light glides across the text on a loop, like polished metal catching a lamp.

items.name: sparkles-text
items.title: Sparkles Text
items.description: Text with little four-point stars that twinkle in and out around it. The stars hold still under reduced motion.

items.name: spinning-text
items.title: Spinning Text
items.description: Letters set around a circle that turns forever, in either direction. Holds still under reduced motion.

items.name: spoiler-text
items.title: Spoiler Text
items.description: Text hidden under a shimmering field of specks. Click or press Enter to blow them away and read it. Screen readers hear a spoiler button until it opens.

items.name: wave-text
items.title: Wave Text
items.description: A gentle wave rolls through the letters, each one a beat behind its neighbour.

items.name: shader-background
items.title: Shader Background
items.description: A soft, flowing noise field drawn by a raw WebGL shader in your theme colors. Sleeps off screen, falls back to a CSS gradient.

items.name: dot-field
items.title: Dot Field
items.description: A halftone of dots on a springy membrane. A swipe drags the dots and a click sends a ring through them.

items.name: flickering-grid
items.title: Flickering Grid
items.description: A grid of small squares that blink between dim and bright on a canvas. Stills under reduced motion and rests off screen.

items.name: flow-field
items.title: Flow Field
items.description: Wind drawn as streamlines on a canvas. The cursor is a disc the air flows around. Rests off screen and stills under reduced motion.

items.name: glyph-matrix
items.title: Glyph Matrix
items.description: A grid of monospace glyphs where a few cells at a time swap character and brightness. Fades towards the bottom and stills under reduced motion.

items.name: halftone-background
items.title: Halftone Background
items.description: A halftone print on a canvas: a rotated screen of dots sized by the ink a lit sphere takes, with a light that circles it or follows the cursor.

items.name: meteors
items.title: Meteors
items.description: Streaks of light that fall across the parent box. Decorative, deterministic, still under reduced motion.

items.name: particles
items.title: Particles
items.description: Specks of light drifting across a canvas that lean towards the cursor. Rests off screen and stills under reduced motion.

items.name: topo-background
items.title: Topo Background
items.description: A drifting topographic map: contour lines traced through a noise terrain on a canvas, with a hill that rises under the cursor.

items.name: diagonal-hatch
items.title: Diagonal Hatch
items.description: Fine diagonal hatching that fades towards the edges, like a sketch shaded with a ruler.

items.name: dot-grid
items.title: Dot Grid
items.description: A dot grid with a fine grain and soft edges. Dots near the cursor take the primary color and grow.

items.name: graph-paper
items.title: Graph Paper
items.description: Engineering graph paper: fine squares with a stronger line every few cells, fading out towards the edges.

items.name: hexagon-pattern
items.title: Hexagon Pattern
items.description: A honeycomb of hairline hexagons drawn as one repeating SVG pattern, with optional filled cells and an edge fade.

items.name: retro-grid
items.title: Retro Grid
items.description: A perspective grid that scrolls toward the viewer. Pure CSS 3D, no canvas. Decorative and still under reduced motion.

items.name: aurora-background
items.title: Aurora Background
items.description: A slow, blurred aurora drifting behind your content. Tinted from the primary token, paused off screen, still under reduced motion.

items.name: light-rays
items.title: Light Rays
items.description: Soft shafts of light that fade in, sway and fade out over two corner glows. Holds a still pose under reduced motion.

items.name: mesh-glow
items.title: Mesh Glow
items.description: Soft blurred glows over a fine grid with a calm vignette. Drifts slowly, or holds still.

items.name: cursor-follow
items.title: Cursor Follow
items.description: Replaces the system cursor inside an area with a spring-smoothed bubble that grows into a text label over elements marked with data-cursor-text.

items.name: cursor-image-trail
items.title: Cursor Image Trail
items.description: Drops a pool of images or cards along the pointer's path inside an area, larger and longer-lived the faster you move.

items.name: drawing-cursor
items.title: Drawing Cursor
items.description: The cursor leaves a smooth ink line on a click-through canvas that thins when you move fast and fades as it dries.

items.name: smooth-cursor
items.title: Smooth Cursor
items.description: Replaces the system cursor inside an area with a spring-smoothed arrow that turns toward the direction of travel.

items.name: spotlight
items.title: Spotlight
items.description: A soft primary-tinted light that follows the pointer across a card, with an optional glow on the nearest edge.

items.name: magnetic
items.title: Magnetic
items.description: Pulls a button or icon toward the pointer on a spring when the cursor comes close.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt Card
items.description: A card that tilts toward the pointer in 3D on a spring, with an optional soft glare that follows the cursor.

items.name: click-ripple
items.title: Click Ripple
items.description: Sends rings of the primary color out from every click inside an area, on a click-through layer. Off on touch screens and under reduced motion.

items.name: cool-mode
items.title: Cool Mode
items.description: Sprays coloured particles or emoji from the cursor while a button is pressed, drawn on a click-through canvas.

items.name: bell-button
items.title: Bell Button
items.description: A notification toggle whose bell swings and rings when switched on, with an unread badge, and goes quiet with a slash when off.

items.name: clip-corners-button
items.title: Clip Corners Button
items.description: A tech-style button with shaved corners that cut deeper on hover and keyboard focus.

items.name: command-button
items.title: Command Button
items.description: A button that draws its keyboard shortcut as physical keycaps. The shortcut works page-wide: caps sink as keys go down and the button clicks on a match.

items.name: dot-morph-button
items.title: Dot Morph Button
items.description: A pill button whose leading dot springs into a tall bar on hover and keyboard focus. Stays a dot on touch screens and under reduced motion.

items.name: family-button
items.title: Family Button
items.description: A square button that springs open into a panel and collapses back. The toggle rotates from plus to close.

items.name: shimmer-button
items.title: Shimmer Button
items.description: A button with a light that circles its edge. Stops when disabled or under reduced motion.

items.name: slide-text-button
items.title: Slide Text Button
items.description: A button whose label slides up and is replaced by a second label on hover or keyboard focus. Renders as a button or a link.

items.name: double-tap-button
items.title: Double Tap Button
items.description: A destructive action that needs two presses: the first arms it with a draining fuse, the second inside the window confirms. Waiting or blur disarms it.

items.name: hold-action-button
items.title: Hold Action Button
items.description: A button that confirms only after being held down, with a fill that rewinds on early release. Works with pointer and Space / Enter, announces completion, and completes without animation under reduced motion.

items.name: slide-to-confirm
items.title: Slide to Confirm
items.description: A slide-to-commit control for irreversible actions: drag the thumb to the end, or press Enter, Space or the right arrow. Shows busy and done states.

items.name: undo-button
items.title: Undo Button
items.description: A button that acts at once, then holds the real commit back for a short undo window with a draining bar and a Ctrl/Cmd+Z shortcut.

items.name: morph-toggle
items.title: Morph Toggle
items.description: A switch with a spring thumb that can morph from a rounded square to a circle, or carry an icon that turns as it flips.

items.name: theme-switch
items.title: Theme Switch
items.description: A sun and moon switch: a sliding mask bites the sun into a crescent while its rays fold away. Reports the theme and leaves applying it to you.

items.name: folder-reveal
items.title: Folder Reveal
items.description: A folder that fans its cards out when opened: the flap tips forward and the cards rise and spread, on hover, click or keyboard.

items.name: hover-swap-card
items.title: Hover Swap Card
items.description: A card that swaps its title and visual and lifts the media on hover or keyboard focus. Pure CSS transitions.

items.name: shift-card
items.title: Shift Card
items.description: A card whose bottom panel grows over the middle content on hover, focus or click, swapping what the top shows.

items.name: card-flip
items.title: Card Flip
items.description: A card that turns over on a spring to show its back, on click, Enter or Space, or optionally while a mouse hovers it.

items.name: photo-stack
items.title: Photo Stack
items.description: A deck of offset cards. Click, press Enter or Space, or drag the top card to send it to the back and reveal the next.

items.name: time-machine-stack
items.title: Time Machine Stack
items.description: A stack that reaches back through time: older cards peek out above the front one, and Newer, Older or the arrow keys step through them.

items.name: border-beam
items.title: Border Beam
items.description: A light that travels around the border of its parent card. Decorative, follows the parent's radius.

items.name: emboss-surface
items.title: Emboss Surface
items.description: A surface carved by light: raised, pressed in or stamped, with the relief following a light angle you set or the pointer. Can carve just the text.

items.name: glass-card
items.title: Glass Card
items.description: A frosted glass pane with blurred backdrop, a polished rim and a specular highlight that follows the pointer.

items.name: glow-hover-card
items.title: Glow Hover Cards
items.description: A grid of cards lit by one shared glow: borders and fills light up under the pointer and carry across neighbouring cards.

items.name: holographic-foil
items.title: Holographic Foil
items.description: A card with a holographic foil layer: theme-colored bands shift and a glare slides across as the pointer moves.

items.name: texture-card
items.title: Texture Card
items.description: A card framed by nested hairline borders for a machined, tactile edge. Ships header, title, description, content, footer and separator parts.

items.name: card-field
items.title: Card Field
items.description: A one-row card input for checkout. The number groups by brand, then slides away to its last four digits to make room for expiry and security code.

items.name: float-input
items.title: Float Input
items.description: A text field whose label starts inside the box and floats up when you focus or type.

items.name: otp-boxed-input
items.title: OTP Boxed Input
items.description: A one-time-code field of separate boxes with paste, arrow-key navigation, error state and a resend countdown.

items.name: detent-dial
items.title: Detent Dial
items.description: A rotary knob that clicks from notch to notch, with a swelling tick ring, flick momentum and a rolling readout.

items.name: liquid-slider
items.title: Liquid Slider
items.description: A glass of water you fill by dragging its surface. The liquid sloshes and bubbles; under reduced motion it just rises.

items.name: scrubber
items.title: Scrubber
items.description: A horizontal value scrubber: drag across a labelled track to set a number, with tick marks and a capsule thumb.

items.name: duration-picker
items.title: Duration Picker
items.description: Hours, minutes and seconds as separate segments you type into, step with the keyboard or scrub by dragging, with rolling digits.

items.name: week-strip-calendar
items.title: Week Strip Calendar
items.description: A one-week date strip: step between weeks with the arrows and tap a day to select it.

items.name: wheel-picker
items.title: Wheel Picker
items.description: An iOS-style drum picker: real 3D cylinders you drag, flick, scroll or step with the keyboard.

items.name: dimple-switch
items.title: Dimple Switch
items.description: A chunky physical-looking switch: a dimpled knob slides along an inset track.

items.name: segmented-toggle-button
items.title: Segmented Toggle Button
items.description: An iOS-style segmented control with a pill that slides under the active label.

items.name: tip-selector
items.title: Tip Selector
items.description: A checkout tip picker set on a draggable tape with preset chips, a Round up shortcut and rolling totals.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: A drop zone with an upload queue: drop, paste or browse, watch progress per file, cancel or retry. Simulated locally unless you pass onUpload.

items.name: signature-pad
items.title: Signature Pad
items.description: A canvas to sign on with mouse, touch or pen. Ink is sprung and thins with speed; the result comes out as SVG.

items.name: collab-toolbar
items.title: Collab Toolbar
items.description: A floating toolbar of icon buttons and a collaborator avatar stack, split into groups by dividers.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: A row of icons that swell as the pointer approaches, macOS style. Stays at rest on touch and under reduced motion.

items.name: fluid-hover-highlight
items.title: Fluid Hover Highlight
items.description: One highlight that glides between list rows under the pointer or keyboard focus instead of blinking on hover.

items.name: kebab-actions-dropdown
items.title: Kebab Actions Dropdown
items.description: A row with a kebab button that expands its action menu inside the same card, with arrow-key navigation.

items.name: marking-menu
items.title: Marking Menu
items.description: A radial menu you open by holding, flicking or right-clicking a surface, with a keyboard path through a Menu button.

items.name: morph-surface
items.title: Morph Surface
items.description: A small pill that morphs into a feedback form and back, with a shared dot and a check on success.

items.name: profile-dropdown
items.title: Profile Dropdown
items.description: An account menu that grows out of its own trigger, with status, theme, links, account switching and a hold-to-confirm sign out.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A breadcrumb trail whose items slide in one after another. Marks the last item as the current page.

items.name: direction-aware-tabs
items.title: Direction Aware Tabs
items.description: Tabs whose panel slides in from the side you are moving towards, with a sliding pill and an animated panel height.

items.name: linen-tab-button
items.title: Linen Tab Button
items.description: A button with a woven linen face, dashed stitching and a soft lift on press.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page navigation with ellipses and a sliding indicator behind the active page.

items.name: bounce-sidebar
items.title: Bounce Sidebar
items.description: A vertical nav with a dot that hops along a curved path to the selected item.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A collapsible app rail that animates between full width and an icon rail, with menu buttons and a trigger.

items.name: action-search-bar
items.title: Action Search Bar
items.description: A command palette in a search bar: fuzzy search, nested pages, recent rows, shortcut hints and in-row progress.

items.name: favicon-search
items.title: Favicon Search
items.description: A search field with a keyboard-driven result list that shows an icon, title and description per row.

items.name: search-input
items.title: Search Input
items.description: A search field with a leading icon, a clear button, a hint and an error state.

items.name: modal-dialog
items.title: Modal Dialog
items.description: A centered modal with focus trap, Escape, scroll lock and focus return, plus an alertdialog mode for confirmations. Fades without motion under reduced motion.

items.name: sheet-drawer
items.title: Sheet Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides in from the right, left or bottom over a dimmed page, with focus trap and Escape. The bottom sheet drags down to dismiss; no slide under reduced motion.

items.name: morph-popover
items.title: Morph Popover
items.description: A button that morphs into a small feedback form, its label becoming the panel title. Escape or an outside click folds it back; it swaps without morphing under reduced motion.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label for a control that shows on hover and keyboard focus, wired with aria-describedby. Escape hides it; it only fades under reduced motion.

items.name: lens
items.title: Lens
items.description: A round magnifying lens that follows the pointer over any content. Mouse and trackpad only: touch screens and reduced motion get the plain content. The magnified copy is hidden from assistive tech.

items.name: lightbox-grid
items.title: Lightbox Grid
items.description: A grid of tiles that opens into a full-screen viewer with previous/next, arrow keys, Escape and a focus trap. Opens without scaling under reduced motion.

items.name: blur-scrim
items.title: Blur Scrim
items.description: A blur-and-dim layer that covers its container instead of the page, with content centred on top. Click or Escape dismisses it; no fade under reduced motion.

items.name: progressive-blur
items.title: Progressive Blur
items.description: A gradual blur over the edge of a scrolling area, built from stacked backdrop-filter layers. Decorative and static.

items.name: animated-list
items.title: Animated List
items.description: Adds its children one at a time, newest on top, with a springy push. Shows everything at once under reduced motion.

items.name: hover-image-list
items.title: Hover Image List
items.description: A text list that reveals a preview for the row you point at; the preview trails the cursor on desktop and sits beside the list on touch, with focus and reduced motion.

items.name: pinned-list
items.title: Pinned List
items.description: A list where any row can be pinned. Pinned rows rise to the top and the others close the gap with a spring; rows jump under reduced motion.

items.name: coverflow-carousel
items.title: Coverflow Carousel
items.description: A 3D coverflow where the centre slide faces front and its neighbours tilt away. Drag, buttons and arrow keys; flat and fading under reduced motion.

items.name: drag-carousel
items.title: Drag Carousel
items.description: A free-scrolling row of slides with elastic drag, plus arrow-key and button stepping.

items.name: image-accordion
items.title: Image Accordion
items.description: A row of image panels where one is wide and the rest are slim. The open panel follows hover, focus or click and reveals its title.

items.name: thumbnail-carousel
items.title: Thumbnail Carousel
items.description: A swipeable slide with a thumbnail strip underneath. The active thumbnail widens and the strip glides to centre it.

items.name: smooth-accordion
items.title: Smooth Accordion
items.description: A stack of disclosures with panels that grow to their content, single or multiple mode, and full keyboard navigation.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: Endless horizontal or vertical loop of any content, with pause on hover and a still frame under reduced motion.

items.name: orbiting-circles
items.title: Orbiting Circles
items.description: Spreads its children around a ring and walks them around it. Items stay upright and rest under reduced motion.

items.name: scroll-velocity-marquee
items.title: Scroll Velocity Marquee
items.description: A marquee that crawls on its own and speeds up or reverses with how fast the page scrolls. Pauses off screen and stays still under reduced motion.

items.name: animated-beam
items.title: Animated Beam
items.description: A light that flows along a curved path between two elements, for integration diagrams. Holds a still path under reduced motion and pauses off screen.

items.name: bento-grid
items.title: Bento Grid
items.description: Container-responsive bento grid with cards that lift on hover, move their artwork and follow the pointer with a soft glow.

items.name: shuffle-grid
items.title: Shuffle Grid
items.description: A grid whose tiles glide to new places when shuffled or reset. Tiles jump instead under reduced motion.

items.name: scroll-progress
items.title: Scroll Progress
items.description: A thin bar that fills as you scroll the page or any scroll container.

items.name: svg-draw-on-scroll
items.title: SVG Draw on Scroll
items.description: SVG strokes that draw themselves as the element scrolls through view, one path after another. Fully drawn under reduced motion.

items.name: scroll-image-reveal
items.title: Scroll Image Reveal
items.description: A frame that opens with a wipe, curtain or circle as it scrolls into view, with counter-parallax inside. Open and still under reduced motion.

items.name: scroll-reveal-paragraph
items.title: Scroll Reveal Paragraph
items.description: A paragraph whose words go from faint to full strength one by one as it scrolls into view. Fully lit under reduced motion.

items.name: parallax-layers
items.title: Parallax Layers
items.description: A stack of layers that drift at different speeds as the scene scrolls past. Layers stay put under reduced motion.

items.name: orbit-loader
items.title: Orbit Loader
items.description: Dots circling on nested rings at different speeds. Under reduced motion it holds one evenly spread frame.

items.name: ring-spinner
items.title: Ring Spinner
items.description: A minimal indeterminate ring in three sizes that takes its color from the surrounding text.

items.name: thinking-loader
items.title: Thinking Loader
items.description: A calm waiting indicator in three shapes (dots, bar, grid) that share one tempo and never fake progress.

items.name: shimmer-skeleton
items.title: Shimmer Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder block with a soft light sweeping across it. Wrap real content and it keeps the exact size.

items.name: skeleton-reveal
items.title: Skeleton Reveal
items.description: Wraps real content and swaps a placeholder for it with a cross-fade. The content is always laid out, so nothing shifts when it arrives.

items.name: progress-ring
items.title: Progress Ring
items.description: A determinate ring that eases to its value and counts up in the middle.

items.name: stacked-meter
items.title: Stacked Meter
items.description: A capacity bar split into labelled parts, like storage by file type, with a legend that highlights each part and shows the free space.

items.name: step-progress
items.title: Step Progress
items.description: One progress bar cut into a segment per step with labels underneath. Finished steps are full, the current one fills as far as you say.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline notice with an optional icon, title and body in four tones. Warnings and errors interrupt screen readers; info and success are polite.

items.name: animated-subscribe-button
items.title: Animated Subscribe Button
items.description: A toggle button whose label slides away and the next one drops in. A real button with aria-pressed, in controlled or uncontrolled form.

items.name: animated-toast-stack
items.title: Animated Toast Stack
items.description: A stack of toasts that spring in with a blur, swap their icon and text in place, swipe away and expire on a timer. Includes a hook to drive it.

items.name: notification-banner
items.title: Notification Banner
items.description: A small snackbar with a check icon, an optional action and a close button. Slides up, fades out on dismiss and leaves a button to bring it back.

items.name: notification-stack
items.title: Notification Stack
items.description: A pile of notifications that fans out on hover or focus. Swipe, click or press Delete to dismiss; the remaining cards close the gap.

items.name: speech-bubble
items.title: Speech Bubble
items.description: A pill-shaped chat bubble with a curved tail and a blinking caret. Calm and still under reduced motion.

items.name: announcement
items.title: Announcement
items.description: A pill that announces something new: a small tag followed by a title. Render it as a link to make the whole pill clickable.

items.name: count-badge
items.title: Count Badge
items.description: A badge for the corner of an avatar or icon: a dot, a rolling count with a cap, or a presence dot, with an optional pulse.

items.name: dynamic-island
items.title: Dynamic Island
items.description: A pill that springs open into richer views, in the style of the iPhone status island. The shell animates real size, so content is never distorted.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: A first-run or no-results state: an optional icon, a heading, a supporting sentence and an action.

items.name: radar-badge
items.title: Radar Badge
items.description: A live-monitoring badge: a tiny radar sweep with spreading rings next to a label, in live, scanning, idle and alert states.

items.name: security-checkpoint
items.title: Security Checkpoint
items.description: A browser-verification card with lines that draw in from the side; the blocked ones stop at the card with a glowing dot. Draws instantly under reduced motion.

items.name: status-dot
items.title: Status Dot
items.description: A pill with a pulsing status dot and a label for service states: online, offline, maintenance or degraded.

items.name: unlock-face-id
items.title: Unlock Face ID
items.description: A Face ID style unlock: brackets and a face draw themselves, a scan line sweeps, then a check reveals the blurred content behind it. Controlled or self-running.

items.name: ai-message
items.title: AI Message
items.description: A chat message bubble for a user or an assistant, with copy, retry and thumbs buttons that appear on hover and on keyboard focus.

items.name: ai-prompt-input
items.title: AI Prompt Input
items.description: A chat prompt box that grows with the text. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line, and the send button turns into a stop button while the model answers.

items.name: ai-sources
items.title: AI Sources
items.description: A "Used N sources" toggle that opens into a numbered list of links, for showing where an answer came from.

items.name: ai-suggestions
items.title: AI Suggestions
items.description: Prompt suggestion chips for an empty chat or the follow-ups after an answer. They pop in from the middle outward.

items.name: ai-typing-indicator
items.title: AI Typing Indicator
items.description: Three bouncing dots in a chat bubble that show someone is typing. Level and calm under reduced motion.

items.name: ai-reasoning
items.title: AI Reasoning
items.description: A collapsible reasoning trace. The summary shimmers only while the model is working, then settles, reports how long it took and folds away.

items.name: ai-context-meter
items.title: AI Context Meter
items.description: A small ring and token count for the model's context window. The ring changes color near the limit, and a popover lists what fills it.

items.name: ai-task-list
items.title: AI Task List
items.description: The plan an agent is working through: rows with pending, running, done and failed states, sub-steps, and a done/total count worked out from the rows.

items.name: ai-tool-approval
items.title: AI Tool Approval
items.description: A card where the user approves or denies an agent's tool call, showing the command or fields, the reason, and a polite live announcement of the decision.

items.name: ai-tool-call
items.title: AI Tool Call
items.description: One agent tool call as a single line with a status ring that turns from queued to running to done or failed. Opens to show arguments and result.

items.name: ai-orb
items.title: AI Orb
items.description: A soft glowing orb for a voice assistant with four states: idle, listening, thinking and speaking. Still and calm under reduced motion.

items.name: ai-voice-wave
items.title: AI Voice Wave
items.description: A row of bars for voice input or output. Feed it live levels or let it pulse on its own while active. Static and level-shaped under reduced motion.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar Chart
items.description: A vertical bar chart made of plain divs. The tallest bar is highlighted, values show on hover or all the time, and the full data is read aloud.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut Chart
items.description: A donut chart in plain SVG that draws in slice by slice. The legend gives every share as text, and the total sits in the hole.

items.name: heatmap-calendar
items.title: Heatmap Calendar
items.description: A contribution-style grid of days in weekly columns, darker for busier days. Hover or focus a day to read it; the total is the caption.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A tiny line chart with no axes for rows, cards and tables. Plain SVG, optional area and end dot, with a spoken summary of the range.

items.name: kpi-card
items.title: KPI Card
items.description: A metric card with a label, a big number, the change since last period and an optional sparkline. Good and bad changes are colored and also spoken.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: A sortable table with real table markup. Click a heading to sort ascending, descending, then back to the original order. Numbers sort as numbers.

items.name: uptime-card
items.title: Uptime Card
items.description: A status card with a row of daily bars per service, an uptime percentage and a short list of recent incidents. Bars are readable by screen readers and inspectable with the keyboard.

items.name: comparison-slider
items.title: Comparison Slider
items.description: A before/after reveal split by a draggable divider that is also a keyboard slider (arrows, page keys, home and end).

items.name: android-mockup
items.title: Android Mockup
items.description: A phone frame with a punch-hole camera and a gesture bar, drawn with theme tokens. Anything you pass becomes the screen.

items.name: iphone-mockup
items.title: iPhone Mockup
items.description: A phone frame with a dynamic island and side buttons, drawn with theme tokens. Anything you pass becomes the screen.

items.name: laptop-mockup
items.title: Laptop Mockup
items.description: A laptop with a 16:10 screen and a hinged base, drawn with theme tokens. Anything you pass becomes the screen.

items.name: safari-mockup
items.title: Safari Mockup
items.description: A browser window with traffic lights, toolbar icons and an address pill, drawn with theme tokens around any content.

items.name: terminal
items.title: Terminal
items.description: A terminal window that plays its lines in sequence: typed commands and fading output. Shows everything at once under reduced motion.

items.name: audio-equalizer
items.title: Audio Equalizer
items.description: Level bars that bounce while audio plays and settle into a calm wave when it stops or when motion is reduced.

items.name: audio-player
items.title: Audio Player
items.description: A compact track card with cover, play and pause, a seek slider with times and a mute toggle. It runs its own clock, so it needs no audio file.

items.name: video-player-ui
items.title: Video Player UI
items.description: Video controls on a 16:9 stage: a big play button, scrub bar, time readout, speed cycle and fullscreen. It runs its own clock and loads no media.

items.name: candlestick-chart
items.title: Candlestick Chart
items.description: OHLC candles with volume bars, a last-price line and a keyboard-friendly crosshair readout, drawn in plain SVG.

items.name: depth-chart
items.title: Depth Chart
items.description: Cumulative buy and sell depth as two stepped areas meeting at the spread, with a keyboard-operable level readout, in plain SVG.

items.name: liquidity-heatmap
items.title: Liquidity Heatmap
items.description: Resting liquidity by price level over time as a grid of cells whose strength follows the size, with a current-price row and an arrow-key readout.

items.name: order-book
items.title: Order Book
items.description: A depth ladder with asks above and bids below, cumulative depth bars, a spread bar and a fill-cost readout on hover. Driven by snapshots passed as props.

items.name: prediction-market-bar
items.title: Prediction Market Bar
items.description: A binary market card: the question, the chance of Yes, a split odds bar and Yes and No share prices as buttons. Data in, no wallet.

items.name: price-target-fan
items.title: Price Target Fan
items.description: Recent price history followed by a cone from the low to the high target, with the average as a dashed line and the move against today's price.

items.name: price-ticker
items.title: Price Ticker
items.description: A price that rolls its digits on every update, flashes green or red, and shows a percent change badge.

items.name: volume-profile
items.title: Volume Profile
items.description: Volume traded at each price level as horizontal bars, with the point of control, value area and an inspect-by-keyboard readout, in plain SVG.

items.name: address-chip
items.title: Address Chip
items.description: A compact EVM address with a generated blockie-style avatar, copy button, ENS label and explorer link.

items.name: wallet-card
items.title: Wallet Card
items.description: A stack of payment-style cards with a pointer sheen: pick one to bring it forward, mask the balance and see who shares it.

items.name: currency-transfer
items.title: Currency Transfer
items.description: A transfer receipt that follows money through four steps, rolls the amount into the new currency and offers a copyable reference.

items.name: receipt-printer
items.title: Receipt Printer
items.description: A transaction receipt (hash, from, to, amount, fee, status) that feeds out of a printer slot one line at a time, with a serrated edge.

items.name: swap-panel
items.title: Swap Panel
items.description: A cross-chain swap ticket: pay and receive fields, a token picker with chain filter, a live quote and an optional destination address.

items.name: tx-steps
items.title: Transaction Steps
items.description: Step-by-step transaction status (Approve, Sign, Broadcast, Confirmed) with a spinning active step, checkmarks and error state.

items.name: amount-pad
items.title: Amount Pad
items.description: A number pad for entering a token amount: animated digits, presets, a per-transfer cap, shake on refusal and physical keyboard input.

items.name: amount-stepper
items.title: Amount Stepper
items.description: Minus, amount and plus in one inline control: decimal steps, min and max, and a ticker label for token amounts.

items.name: navbar-announce
items.title: Navbar Announcement
items.description: A dismissible announcement strip above a bar whose links share one soft highlight that glides between them.

items.name: navbar-fixed
items.title: Navbar Fixed
items.description: Full-width top bar that sticks or pins to the viewport, with links, a quiet action and a filled call to action.

items.name: navbar-floating
items.title: Navbar Floating
items.description: A rounded pill nav that floats inset from the top with a blurred backdrop and a call to action, easing in on mount.

items.name: navbar-mega
items.title: Navbar Mega Menu
items.description: Top bar with full-width mega-menu panels and its own focus management: arrow keys, Escape and click-away all behave.

items.name: navbar-mobile
items.title: Navbar Mobile Menu
items.description: Top bar that folds into a menu button on narrow containers, with focus moved into the open menu, a Tab loop and Escape to close.

items.name: hero-aurora-center
items.title: Hero Aurora Center
items.description: Full-bleed hero on a drifting aurora with a glass strip of three highlights along the bottom.

items.name: hero-dashboard-peek
items.title: Hero Dashboard Peek
items.description: Centered hero with an announcement pill whose product dashboard rises from the bottom edge and fades under the fold.

items.name: hero-email-waitlist
items.title: Hero Email Waitlist
items.description: Centered waitlist hero with one email field, inline validation and a thank-you state.

items.name: hero-giant-type
items.title: Hero Giant Type
items.description: Typographic hero: oversized words rise line by line, with a services list and a call to action below.

items.name: hero-logo-cloud
items.title: Hero Logo Cloud
items.description: Inverted hero panel with a centered headline, two buttons and a row of customer logos along the bottom.

items.name: hero-phone-split
items.title: Hero Phone Split
items.description: Split hero with copy and buttons beside a phone mock-up that carries two softly floating cards.

items.name: hero-prompt-card
items.title: Hero Prompt Card
items.description: Centered hero with a live prompt card: pick a project type and the brief underneath rewrites itself.

items.name: hero-section
items.title: Hero Section
items.description: Landing hero with an eyebrow pill, headline, copy, two calls to action and an optional media slot, revealed in a soft stagger.

items.name: hero-stat-strip
items.title: Hero Stat Strip
items.description: Left-aligned hero with a column of counting figures on the right, split by hairlines.

items.name: hero-store-badges
items.title: Hero Store Badges
items.description: App-download hero with a social proof pill, a huge two-line headline and store buttons on a warm glow.

items.name: hero-terminal-install
items.title: Hero Terminal Install
items.description: Developer hero with a copyable install command beside a terminal that plays the install.

items.name: logos-grid
items.title: Logos Grid
items.description: Logos in a ruled grid where each gets its own bordered cell that brightens on hover; cells can be links.

items.name: logos-marquee
items.title: Logos Marquee
items.description: A heading over an endless strip of logos that fades at both edges and pauses on hover. Still under reduced motion.

items.name: logos-row
items.title: Logos Row
items.description: A single quiet line: a label, a hairline rule and a row of logos that wraps on narrow containers.

items.name: logos-split
items.title: Logos Split
items.description: Headline, copy and a link on the left, logos as bordered tiles on the right; stacks on narrow containers.

items.name: features-accordion-media
items.title: Features Accordion Media
items.description: An accordion of features beside a preview panel that cross-fades to match the open row.

items.name: features-alternating
items.title: Features Alternating
items.description: Zig-zag rows with copy on one side and media on the other, swapping sides down the page.

items.name: features-bento
items.title: Features Bento
items.description: A headline beside its intro copy, over a dense bento grid of feature tiles with artwork.

items.name: features-checklist
items.title: Features Checklist
items.description: Copy and a call to action beside a two-column list of included capabilities, in one rounded panel.

items.name: features-comparison
items.title: Features Comparison
items.description: A real table that compares products or plans feature by feature, with check and cross marks and one highlighted column.

items.name: features-hover-expand
items.title: Features Hover Expand
items.description: A row of panels where the one you point at, focus or select grows to reveal its copy.

items.name: features-icon-grid
items.title: Features Icon Grid
items.description: A headline over a responsive grid of icon cards that rise in one after another.

items.name: features-integrations-beam
items.title: Features Integrations Beam
items.description: Copy beside a hub diagram where beams of light connect tools on both sides to your product.

items.name: features-marquee
items.title: Features Marquee
items.description: Rows of small feature chips that drift in alternating directions under a centered headline.

items.name: features-metrics-beam
items.title: Features Metrics Beam
items.description: A lead metric card ringed by a travelling light, with the remaining proof points stacked beside it.

items.name: features-numbered
items.title: Features Numbered
items.description: Editorial columns without cards: a rule, an oversized numeral, a title and a line of copy.

items.name: features-showcase
items.title: Features Showcase
items.description: A product shot in the middle with feature callouts on both sides, stacking under it on narrow containers.

items.name: features-steps
items.title: Features Steps
items.description: A numbered vertical timeline: a sticky headline on one side, steps joined by a rail on the other.

items.name: features-sticky-list
items.title: Features Sticky List
items.description: A headline that stays pinned while tall feature cards with visuals scroll past it.

items.name: features-tabs
items.title: Features Tabs
items.description: Pill tabs where each tab opens a panel with copy, bullets and a visual that slides in from the side you move towards.

items.name: features-terminal
items.title: Features Terminal
items.description: A feature list beside a terminal that types a command and prints the result.

items.name: stats-band
items.title: Stats Band
items.description: A single filled strip of counting stats separated by hairlines, made to sit between two sections.

items.name: stats-editorial-list
items.title: Stats Editorial List
items.description: Oversized numbers in ruled rows, each with its explanation beside it, like a magazine spread.

items.name: stats-grid
items.title: Stats Grid
items.description: A centered headline over a grid of cards, each with a big number that counts up as it scrolls into view.

items.name: stats-progress-bars
items.title: Stats Progress Bars
items.description: A headline beside a stack of labelled bars that fill to their percentage as they scroll into view.

items.name: stats-sparkline-cards
items.title: Stats Sparkline Cards
items.description: Cards that pair a counting number with a small line chart of its recent history that draws itself in.

items.name: stats-split-feature
items.title: Stats Split Feature
items.description: The story and a link on the left, a two by two grid of ruled, counting stats on the right.

items.name: stats-trend-cards
items.title: Stats Trend Cards
items.description: Left-aligned metric cards with a corner icon, a counting number and a green or red change chip.

items.name: testimonial-carousel
items.title: Testimonial Carousel
items.description: One testimonial at a time with previous and next buttons, dots, a counter and arrow keys. No autoplay.

items.name: testimonial-chat
items.title: Testimonial Chat
items.description: Testimonials as a chat thread: bubbles on alternating sides with initials avatars, revealed in a soft stagger.

items.name: testimonial-featured
items.title: Testimonial Featured
items.description: One large centered quote with its author, backed by a row of shorter supporting quotes.

items.name: testimonial-marquee
items.title: Testimonial Marquee
items.description: Rows of testimonial cards drifting in opposite directions with faded edges. Built on Marquee; still under reduced motion.

items.name: testimonial-metrics
items.title: Testimonial Metrics
items.description: Cards that lead with one big result and back it up with a short quote and author.

items.name: testimonial-spotlight
items.title: Testimonial Spotlight
items.description: A row of initials avatars; the one you pick takes the spotlight with a large quote.

items.name: testimonial-stack
items.title: Testimonial Stack
items.description: A pile of testimonial cards; Next sends the top card to the back and brings up the one behind it.

items.name: testimonial-vertical-marquee
items.title: Testimonial Vertical Marquee
items.description: Columns of testimonial cards scrolling up and down inside a masked window. Built on Marquee; still under reduced motion.

items.name: testimonial-wall
items.title: Testimonial Wall
items.description: Masonry wall of testimonial cards in one to three columns with optional star ratings and initials avatars.

items.name: pricing-addons-builder
items.title: Pricing Add-ons Builder
items.description: A base plan plus checkable add-ons, with a receipt panel that sums the monthly total.

items.name: pricing-comparison-table
items.title: Pricing Comparison Table
items.description: A feature matrix with plans as columns and grouped features as rows; the recommended plan's column is tinted.

items.name: pricing-credit-packs
items.title: Pricing Credit Packs
items.description: Prepaid credit packs as selectable tiles with a summary bar showing the price per credit.

items.name: pricing-enterprise-split
items.title: Pricing Enterprise Split
items.description: Quick self-serve plans on one side and a dark talk-to-sales card on the other.

items.name: pricing-lifetime-deal
items.title: Pricing Lifetime Deal
items.description: A one-time-payment offer as a ticket-style card with a price stub and a bar for licences left.

items.name: pricing-plan-list
items.title: Pricing Plan List
items.description: Plans as selectable rows with a summary panel that follows the choice and a button to continue.

items.name: pricing-single-card
items.title: Pricing Single Card
items.description: One plan in a single card with a monthly / yearly switch and a price that ticks between the two.

items.name: pricing-tier-cards
items.title: Pricing Tier Cards
items.description: Three side-by-side tier cards with a billing switch; the featured tier sits raised with a badge.

items.name: pricing-usage-slider
items.title: Pricing Usage Slider
items.description: A slider picks the number of seats and the monthly total ticks to match, with a summary panel beside it.

items.name: faq-accordion
items.title: FAQ Accordion
items.description: Centered FAQ with a headline, short intro and one stack of collapsible answers.

items.name: faq-categorized
items.title: FAQ Categorized
items.description: FAQ split into categories: a tab list picks the topic, an accordion holds its answers.

items.name: faq-grid
items.title: FAQ Grid
items.description: Every question and answer on the page at once in a numbered grid, revealed in a soft stagger. No clicks needed.

items.name: faq-journey
items.title: FAQ Journey
items.description: FAQ as a numbered path: a vertical line with one step per question and one answer open at a time.

items.name: faq-searchable
items.title: FAQ Searchable
items.description: FAQ with a search field. Matches in questions and answers narrow the list as you type, with a live count and an empty state.

items.name: faq-split-view
items.title: FAQ Split View
items.description: Question list on one side and the selected answer in a large panel on the other. Keyboard friendly tab pattern.

items.name: faq-two-column
items.title: FAQ Two Column
items.description: Intro and a support card on the left, a stack of collapsible answers on the right. Stacks on narrow containers.

items.name: cta-banner
items.title: CTA Banner
items.description: Slim one-row banner with a short message on the left and a single button on the right.

items.name: cta-beam-card
items.title: CTA Beam Card
items.description: Centered card with a light traveling around its border, a perk list and one strong button.

items.name: cta-centered
items.title: CTA Centered
items.description: Closing call to action with a headline and two buttons centered on a soft radial glow.

items.name: cta-email-inline
items.title: CTA Email Inline
items.description: Card call to action with copy on the left and an inline email form with validation on the right.

items.name: cta-marquee-band
items.title: CTA Marquee Band
items.description: Full-width band of oversized phrases scrolling past, with one button underneath.

items.name: cta-split
items.title: CTA Split
items.description: Two-column call to action with copy and buttons on one side and a product image or mock-up on the other.

items.name: footer-bento
items.title: Footer Bento
items.description: Footer built as a bento of cards: a call to action, social pills, a company link list and a legal strip.

items.name: footer-centered
items.title: Footer Centered
items.description: Centred footer: brand, tagline, a link row with a gliding hover highlight, round social icons and copyright.

items.name: footer-columns
items.title: Footer Columns
items.description: Classic multi-column site footer with a brand block, up to four link groups and a legal bar.

items.name: footer-minimal
items.title: Footer Minimal
items.description: A single-row footer with brand and copyright, a few links and social icons that lift on hover.

items.name: footer-newsletter
items.title: Footer Newsletter
items.description: Footer with an email sign-up form that validates locally and hands the address to a callback, beside the link columns.

items.name: footer-status
items.title: Footer Status
items.description: Dense utility footer with a system status pill, a language switcher, a few links and copyright.

items.name: footer-wordmark
items.title: Footer Wordmark
items.description: Closing footer with a contact line, address and social links above an oversized wordmark that scales with its container.
